subject: RJDBC for custom Databases - Not working in Shiny

messages.author: 7dead4dd4fc5438c
messages.subject: RJDBC for custom Databases - Not working in Shiny
parts:
I am trying to connect shiny with custom database using RJDBC. The codes were working perfectly using R.

I have 4 jar files.. and 1 file for driver..

Input were correct as i copied from R code where its working...

server.R

library(shiny)

  shinyServer(function(input,output)
  {
    output$contents <- renderText({
      
      cp <- strsplit(input$jars,",")[[1]]
      .jinit(classpath=cp)
      drv <- JDBC(input$drname,input$drpath)
      con <- dbConnect(drv,input$dbpath, input$login, input$pwd)
      instanceName <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT count(*) FROM adjintra")
      instanceName
    })
})

library(shiny)

shinyUI(fluidPage(
            "Hello RJDBC",
            sidebarLayout(
              sidebarPanel(
                textInput('jars', 'Enter the Jars Path', "")
                           ,textInput('drname', 'Enter the Driver Name', "")
                           ,textInput('drpath', 'Enter the Driver Path', "")
                           ,textInput('dbpath', 'Enter the database path', "")
                           ,textInput('login', 'Enter the login Path', "")
                           ,textInput('pwd', 'Enter the password', "")
              ), 
              mainPanel( textOutput("contents")
                ))))
